description: Modify an existing customer. Can update name, contact info, addresses, notes, taxable status, active status, hierarchy (parent/sub-customer), delivery method, and payment terms. Set active=false to deactivate (QuickBooks equivalent of delete).

active.description: Set to false to deactivate customer (QuickBooks equivalent of delete)

bill_with_parent.description: Bill this sub-customer with its parent

display_name.description: New display name (must be unique in QuickBooks)

draft.description: If true, validate and show preview without saving (default: true)

job.description: Mark as a job (tracks work for a parent customer)

parent_ref.description: Parent customer name or ID (makes this a sub-customer). Auto-resolved to ID.

preferred_delivery_method.description: How invoices are delivered: Print, Email, or None

sales_term_ref.description: Default payment terms name (e.g., 'Net 30'). Auto-resolved to ID.

name: edit_customer
